metaDescription: Get in touch with Rifat Sarwar.
title: Write to me.
intro: Hiring, collaborating, or own a system that falls over at 3 AM and would like it to stop? This form drafts the email for you; your mail app sends it, and a human (me) reads it.
note: Just a quick question? The AI twin answers instantly. Sarcastically, but instantly.
